context: Living with schizophrenia can present unique challenges when considering PrEP. The user may feel overwhelmed by the stigma around both mental health and sexual health, leading to fear about discussing these topics with healthcare providers. They may also struggle with medication adherence due to their condition, raising concerns about the effectiveness of PrEP in their life.
